other_conditions: Group must consist of at least three faculty members.
One faculty must be Principal Investigator (PI) from a TEQIP host institute.

There must be between two and four Co‑Principal Investigators (Co‑PIs) from TEQIP or non‑TEQIP institutions, including at least one Co‑PI‑1 from the host TEQIP institute belonging to the same department as the PI.
Maximum two proposals can be submitted by a single PI, and only one proposal per PI can be sanctioned at any time.
For institute collaboration, priority is given to TEQIP mentor institutes or NIT/IIT/Central University in the same state or region.
Co‑PIs may be from any institution in India or abroad, or from industrial sectors.
benefits_summary: Maximum funding of ₹25,00,000 with 40% recurring and 60% non‑recurring components.
